judgment.observations: The reconstruction captures the room layout, left-side metal bunks, central wooden cupboard, fireplace and timber-framed wall, but differs substantially in framing and materials. The foreground right bunk occupies much more of the image and obscures the right wall; the left bunks appear smaller and farther away. The reference’s heavy dark ceiling beam, wall clock, radiator and fireplace accessories are absent. The fireplace has a smaller, simplified surround and a flat-looking brick opening. Bedding is flatter and less detailed. The floor is pale and uniform instead of dark, worn boards; wall timbers are lighter, walls cleaner, and metal frames less reflective. The cupboard is simplified, and the render has conspicuous grain. Bed legs visibly meet the floor, but softer contact shadows make objects feel less firmly grounded.
judgment.uncertain_3d_hypotheses: The framing suggests a changed camera position or field of view, possibly combined with different bunk scales or spacing; these causes cannot be separated from the images alone. The fireplace appears shallower and the right bunk closer to the camera, but actual depth and hidden support geometry cannot be established from these views.
